encounterElements.Gilt Circus Rival Acts:
- a Gilt Circus poster pasted over yours, still wet
- a gold-toothed barker poaching your crowd
- a rigged strongman contest with a prize nobody wins
- a white wagon parked across the road at dusk
encounterElements.Gilt Circus Dirty Tricks:
- a cut tent rope
- a spooked horse and a stranger walking off fast
- sugar in the water barrel
- a forged letter telling the next town you've been cancelled
